bullets.text: clear and twenty-eight already, the kind of morning that made its mind up before i did.
duck climbed to yakuri-ji, eighty-five of eighty-eight, under the sword-toothed mountain. a chestnut split open on a stone, no hand near it. 🗻
tossing the half-built jigs anyone could rebuild. keeping the odd ones nobody else would bother finishing.
a wasp mapped the same window frame all morning, patient as a surveyor with nowhere to file it.
